_meta.notes: Form titled '2020 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' filed for the 2024 cycle (Seven days before a primary election, signed 06/18/24). Donor Complete-Mailing-Address column bar-redacted on both Schedule A pages — no city/state survives. Column B (Aggregate Total) prints $0.00 on lines 1 and 2 as printed. Five Schedule B rows (06/19, 06/24, 06/26, 06/27 x2, 06/29/2024) carry dates that post-date the 06/18/24 report date — transcribed verbatim as printed, flagged per row (matches audit note). Many recipient/purpose cells clipped at cell edges by the source form's rendering; legible glyphs transcribed verbatim and flagged per row. 'SOLIDATED DIRECT MAI' (rows 8 and 87) is the same vendor clipped identically twice; every Schedule B page repeats the filing-wide TOTAL $32,298.45 under its page subtotal.
